cases.prompt: I keep having to remind you how we run migrations in this repo. Build a skill for it.
assertions: States a Step 0 verdict on whether this should be a skill at all
Routes to cc rather than runtime
Asks for or gathers the specific things the agent gets wrong today before writing
Produces a description containing literal trigger phrases, not just a statement of what the skill does
Runs validate-skill.cjs and reports it exits 0
Creates evals/evals.json for the new skill with at least one should_trigger false case

cases.prompt: Create a new Ask Cuvama skill that helps the chat agent summarise a discovery's open risks.
assertions: Routes to runtime
Reads reference/runtime-skill-conventions.md before authoring
Does not add a scripts/ directory
Body never names another skill
Uses propose-then-apply if the skill mutates state, or states that it is read-only

cases.prompt: Why isn't my deploy-check skill triggering? I have to type the slash command every time.
assertions: Reads reference/diagnose-and-revise.md before editing anything
Names the symptom row before proposing a fix
Identifies the description as the likely cause and checks for listing truncation
Does not paste the failing query keywords in verbatim

cases.prompt: The chat-analysis skill has gotten bloated and vague. Improve it.
assertions: Treats this as revision, not authoring
Runs a deletion pass before adding anything
Ends with a shorter SKILL.md, or justifies each addition against a failure

cases.prompt: Make a skill that reminds you to always use pnpm instead of npm in this repo.
assertions: Fails this at Step 0 and recommends a CLAUDE.md line instead
Does not build the skill anyway

cases.prompt: Write me a subagent that reviews TSX files for accessibility problems.
cases.note: Subagent authoring is not skill authoring. build-skill may be consulted for the Step 0 distinction but should not claim the task.

cases.prompt: Use the code-review skill on my current diff.
cases.note: Invoking a skill, not building one.

cases.prompt: Build an MCP server that exposes our discovery API to Claude.
cases.note: MCP server authoring shares the word build but none of the format.
